name: gm-tools-review-ui
description: Phase 6 dedicated web review UI: a small node:http server (server.mjs) over mutation-engine/time-skip's existing library modules (via wf-mcp-server/lib/mutation-ops.mjs, shared verbatim with the MCP server), plus a vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend (public/) -- no framework, no build step, matching this project's established convention. No dependencies of its own: every import in server.mjs is a Node built-in or a relative path into mutation-engine/, time-skip/, or wf-mcp-server/lib/, whose own transitive deps (zod, @anthropic-ai/sdk) resolve from GM_Tools/'s root node_modules via Node's normal upward node_modules search.
